arguments.code:
# Find the Woodstock Reimagined: Festival Vibes playlist and determine the most listened song by highest play_count.

access=apis.spotify.login(username='susanmiller@gmail.com', password='%CCvl8v')
access_token=access['access_token']

playlist_query='Woodstock Reimagined: Festival Vibes'

# Fetch playlists from library with the query, then exact-match on title.
page_index=0
page_limit=20
playlists=[]
while True:
    page=apis.spotify.show_playlist_library(access_token=access_token, query=playlist_query, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
    print('playlist page',page_index,'->',page)
    if not page:
        break
    playlists.extend(page)
    page_index+=1

exact=[p for p in playlists if p.get('title','').lower()==playlist_query.lower()]
print('exact playlists',len(exact),exact)

if not exact:
    raise RuntimeError('Playlist not found')

playlist=exact[0]
playlist_id=playlist['playlist_id']
print('using playlist_id',playlist_id,'title',playlist['title'])

# Get songs from the playlist. We only have song_ids from the library listing; fetch full playlist for safety.
plist=apis.spotify.show_playlist(access_token=access_token, playlist_id=playlist_id)
print('playlist detail',plist)

songs=plist.get('songs',[])
print('songs count',len(songs))

# For each song, fetch play_count from show_song.
most=None
for s in songs:
    song_id=s['id']
    det=apis.spotify.show_song(song_id=song_id)
    # Note: show_song response schema includes play_count.
    play_count=det.get('play_count')
    rec={
        'song_id':song_id,
        'title':det.get('title'),
        'artists':[a.get('name') for a in det.get('artists',[])],
        'play_count':play_count,
        'album_title':det.get('album_title')
    }
    print('song',rec)
    if most is None or (play_count is not None and play_count>most['play_count']):
        most=rec

print('MOST',most)
